topics: Research design and scope | Discovery and hosted-search limits
required_constraint: No representative sample or national denominator; uneven discovery and 12,844 unsearched targets.
required_success: The design preserves local comparison discipline and municipality scout coverage reached 99.9579 percent.
required_boundary: Discovery coverage is not national representativeness and unsearched targets have unknown content.

topics: Verification access and storage | Document readiness
required_constraint: Unavailable links access blocks storage-held sources and heterogeneous text layers constrained use.
required_success: Verified locators retained payload hashes and readiness classification preserved usable non-OCR material.
required_boundary: Storage-held and OCR-later sources are outside analyzed evidence and absence cannot be inferred.

topics: Extraction volume and compaction | Analytical framing and table calibration
required_constraint: Raw extraction overproduced repeated or ambiguous hits and the original wage-table focus was too narrow.
required_success: Compaction produced 1,876,183 structured observations and mechanism evidence broadened the useful design.
required_boundary: Millions of rows are not millions of facts and qualitative mechanisms do not become wage estimates.

topics: Rating and semantic review | Reconciliation and comparability
required_constraint: Later administrative evidence lacked GABRIEL scoring and no independent human gold coding; side period role and basis conflicts remained.
required_success: Earlier eligible documentary evidence was rated and 1,726 claim-critical records received bounded semantic review.
required_boundary: Review is not human gold coding and unresolved conflicts do not enter clean calculations.

topics: Safety and non-safety evidence imbalance | Mathematical and causal design
required_constraint: Safety evidence is more readily visible and the external records did not form a compatible wage or growth panel.
required_success: The imbalance is shown explicitly and staffing implementation growth and mechanism evidence remain usable.
required_boundary: Documentation imbalance is not prevalence; no regression national gap or causal estimate is supported.

topics: Locality and visual grouping | Operational and infrastructure limits
required_constraint: Local examples maps grouped categories search failures storage limits and workflow interruptions restrict interpretation.
required_success: Counterexamples remain visible maps use declared units and accepted work survived operational failures.
required_boundary: Local findings remain local and visual concentration is not prevalence or effect size.

topics: What worked what did not and what remains possible
required_constraint: Synthesize all twelve limits without introducing a thirteenth substantive limitation.
required_success: Place concrete completed outputs beside failed designs and future evidence paths.
required_boundary: Future possibilities are research directions not current findings.
